questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Spiders?
choices: Spiders use their bodies, silk, and senses to survive.
Only spiders are arachnids with eight legs and two main body sections.
Only silk egg sacs protect developing spiderlings.
questions.answer: Spiders use their bodies, silk, and senses to survive.
questions.rationale: Spiders are arachnids with eight legs and two main body sections. Other spiders build sheet or tangled webs for different prey. Most spiders cannot harm people and help control insect populations. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Spiders use their bodies, silk, and senses to survive.
